highlights.title: Philippines Lawmaker, Cousin of Marcos, Charged With Taking Kickbacks
highlights.summary: A cousin of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was charged with plundering public funds meant for flood control in the Southeast Asian country. He has denied wrongdoing.

highlights.title: Polls suggest tight presidential race as Brazil marks Independence Day
highlights.summary: Brazil has marked Independence Day with the two main candidates for October’s presidential election holding events.

highlights.title: Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have wounded 73 civilians, official says
highlights.summary: Spokesperson for Saudi-led coalition says Houthis have targeted civilian sites in Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran.

highlights.title: ‘House moved like jelly’ says resident near Bolivia barracks blast
highlights.summary: Reports are emerging from the powerful explosion at a military barracks in Bolivia that killed at least nine people.

highlights.title: Real Madrid vs Inter: Champions League – preview, team news, prediction
highlights.summary: Mourinho kicks off the record 15-time Champions League winners' European campaign against Serie A champions Inter.

highlights.title: Canada’s Retaliatory Tariffs Set to Take Effect as Trump Threatens to Escalate
highlights.summary: New Canadian levies of up to 50 percent are expected to begin Tuesday, even as Washington warns of a new round of American tariffs.
